title: Some updates on my tank shooting game
author: Gloomy_Option205
selftext:
Some updates on my tank shooting game:

Having Machine gun & Rocket, but not fully developed.

The tank can shoot building now

Still working on some updates. 

Created with model Fable 5 on Rezona Lab.

comments.author: FilipeDM
comments.body: Those explosions turned out great, how did you do that?

replies.author: Gloomy_Option205
replies.body: thank you, I just used the built-in effect system on the platform described what I wanted the explosion to look like, tweaked the timing and explosion a few times, you can check the platform [lab.rezona.ai](http://lab.rezona.ai)

replies.author: Jessica___
replies.body: This post smells like an ad.

replies.author: RepulsiveRaisin7
replies.body: For the worst website I have EVER seen no less

comments.author: BJGG69
comments.body: Love the mechanics and the looks, great job. Please share the link with us when you want to do a playtest. One small suggestion - add more recoil to the tank after shooting from the cannon.

replies.author: Gloomy_Option205
replies.body: thank you, I will share around next month, still lot of things need updates

comments.author: DaedalusRaistlin
comments.body:
Beautiful destruction! I love to see it!

I do wonder if you could make that car you sent flying damage the building too? Looks like it didn't interact with it at all. 

Looking great though! I wonder, can players destroy buildings enough that they create alternate avenues and lanes to approach the enemy?

replies.author: Gloomy_Option205
replies.body: Cool, I can, but I want it focus on destroying tanks and cars, buildings are just for fun

replies.author: DaedalusRaistlin
replies.body: Just an idea, it's your game and I think you've got a good handle on it.

comments.author: PleasantUse6352
comments.body: this is the sort of game i'd play for a week straight, maybe you could add a skill tree that gives you different boosts, or maybe you could buy different rockets and tanks; getting money by destroying things!

comments.author: yagudaev
comments.body:
Great job on the destruction and main gameplay feel.

Looks like it has potential. Is there a play link? 🔗
